# WayfinderGEO

> WayfinderGEO helps brands get named, quoted and linked in AI answers. It brings together
> Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI optimization (AIO) and SEO as one system, and
> measures success in citations and share of voice rather than keyword rankings.

Serving clients across Canada and the United States.
New business: hello@wayfindergeo.com. Existing clients: support@wayfindergeo.com.
Usually replies within 1 business day.

## Why it matters

Buyers now ask an AI and get one short answer instead of ten links. Brands named in that
answer make the shortlist; brands that aren't might as well be invisible. Each month a brand
stays out of those answers, a competitor settles in as the default recommendation in its
category.

## What WayfinderGEO does

- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization):** getting a brand named, quoted and linked in AI
  answers to the questions its buyers ask. Includes finding those questions and tracking how
  often the brand is named, seeing where competitors get cited and it doesn't, pages written
  so an AI can quote them cleanly, making sure models know exactly who the brand is, and
  mentions on the sites AI engines already trust.
- **AIO (AI optimization and readability):** making a site easy for AI crawlers to read,
  quote and credit. Includes structured data (schema), llms.txt, crawler access and AI bot
  logs, headings and sections an AI can lift straight into an answer, speed and Core Web
  Vitals, and keeping key pages up to date.
- **SEO (foundational search):** AI answers still start from search results, so a brand that
  is hard to find there is hard to quote. Includes technical audits and crawl health, topical
  authority and internal linking, content planned around what buyers search for, local and
  multi-location visibility, and digital PR with links from trusted sites.

## AI engines tracked

ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Grok, plus the
sources they lean on: Reddit, YouTube and review sites.

## Plans

- **Compass: $1,250, one payment.** For teams who want the full picture and the fundamentals
  fixed, without a retainer. Full audit and a 50-prompt baseline, competitor citation gap
  report, schema, llms.txt and crawler setup, and a 90-day roadmap with a walkthrough call.
- **Beacon: $500 per month.** For small teams and local businesses who need to show up in AI
  answers. Full AI visibility audit and baseline score, tracking on up to 50 priority prompts,
  schema, llms.txt and crawler setup, and two answer-ready pages every month.
- **North Star: $1,500 per month.** For brands competing for the recommendation slot in their
  category. Everything in Beacon, tracking on up to 300 prompts across every major model, six
  answer-ready pages every month, off-site placement and digital PR, and a live dashboard.

No setup fee and no percentage of ad spend. Compass is a single payment with nothing after it.
Monthly plans start with a ninety-day term, then run month to month. Multi-location,
ecommerce catalogue and enterprise scopes are quoted separately. Every engagement can start
with a free AI visibility audit: which engines mention the brand, the prompts where it's
missing, and which competitors take the slot instead.

## How engagements run

1. **Week 1, Baseline:** an AI visibility score on every engine, delivered before anything is billed.
2. **Month 1, Diagnose and build:** first structural fixes live and AI crawler activity measurable.
3. **Month 3, Measure:** a citation trend line you can take into a board meeting.
4. **Month 6 and on, Compound:** share of voice grows as fixes, content and citations stack up.

Technical fixes register within weeks; citation share generally moves between month two and
month four, depending on the category.

## What WayfinderGEO does not claim

It influences what AI models say about a brand; it does not control it. It works on the
brand's own content, the signals that tell models who the brand is, and the wider record of
what the internet says about it.

## Clients

Cleanmeter, IBFNet Group, Crispy Studio, GoodDay and Imaara.
